hero.headline: Rooted in the Word
hero.subheadline: Explore messages that equip, inspire, and transform — grounded in Scripture and delivered with passion.

intro.headline: Teaching Series
intro.subheadline: Dive deep into the Word through our ongoing series, each designed to build your faith and deepen your walk with God.

series.title: Kingdom Light
series.description: Discover what it means to carry the light of Christ's Kingdom into every area of your life.

series.title: The Power of Intercession
series.description: A deep dive into the ministry of prayer — how intercession moves heaven and transforms the earth.

series.title: Walking by Faith
series.description: Faith is not passive — it is active trust in God's promises. This series calls believers to step out boldly.

items.title: You Are the Light of the World
items.description: Pastor Anthony unpacks the mandate every believer carries — to shine with the light of Christ in a world of darkness.

items.title: When Heaven Hears
items.description: A powerful message on the conditions and confidence of effective prayer — and what it means when God moves in response.

items.title: The Evidence of Things Not Seen
items.description: Faith is not blind — it is the substance of hope made real. This message challenges believers to act on what God has spoken.

items.title: Carriers of the Kingdom
items.description: The Kingdom of God is not a distant future — it is within you. Pastor Anthony calls the church to live as Kingdom ambassadors today.

items.title: Praying Without Ceasing
items.description: What does it mean to pray without ceasing? This message reframes prayer as a posture of the heart, not just a scheduled activity.

items.title: Abraham: The Father of Faith
items.description: Abraham believed God against all odds. This foundational message explores what it looks like to trust God when circumstances say otherwise.

cta.headline: Never Miss a Message
cta.subheadline: Join us live every Sunday and Wednesday, or catch up on past messages anytime.
